title: Interfacial hydrogen-bond modulation of dynamic catalysts for nitrate electroreduction to ammonia
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7460-7469
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00597C, Paper
Yuchi Wan, Yixiang Tang, Yinze Zuo, Kaian Sun, Zewen Zhuang, Yun Zheng, Wei Yan, Jiujun Zhang, Ruitao Lv
